title: Printer showing 'Offline' despite being powered on
symptoms: Printer status shows offline on all/some PCs; device itself is powered and connected
resolution:
1. Restart the print spooler service on the affected PC
2. Remove and re-add the printer using its current network address
3. Power-cycle the printer if spooler restart doesn't resolve it

title: Print spooler service won't start (Error 1068)
symptoms: 'Print Spooler service is not running' and manual start fails, often after a Windows update
resolution:
1. Restart the Remote Procedure Call (RPC) service, which the spooler depends on
2. Clear the print spooler queue folder of stuck jobs
3. Reinstall or roll back the printer driver if the issue persists after a clean restart

title: Print jobs stuck in queue, nothing prints
symptoms: Job sits in queue indefinitely; resending doesn't help
resolution:
1. Cancel all stuck jobs and clear the print queue
2. Restart the print spooler service
3. Resend a single test print job before resuming normal use

title: Faded, streaky, or blank printouts
symptoms: Pages print with faded streaks, blank patches, or blank pages despite low-toner warning
resolution:
1. Remove and gently shake the toner/ink cartridge to redistribute remaining toner
2. Run the printer's built-in cleaning/alignment utility
3. Replace cartridge if streaking persists after cleaning

title: Wireless printer disappears from network after Wi-Fi maintenance
symptoms: Printer previously worked over Wi-Fi, no longer appears in device list after network changes
resolution:
1. Confirm printer is connected to the current correct network SSID (may have changed post-maintenance)
2. Re-add the printer via its updated IP or reconnect via the printer's own network setup menu
3. Restart printer and affected PC before re-adding if it still isn't discoverable

title: Repeated paper jams on same printer
symptoms: Paper jams every few pages; clearing visible jam doesn't fully resolve it
resolution:
1. Check paper tray for overfilling, incorrect paper size, or worn feed rollers
2. Fan and realign the paper stack before reloading
3. Clean paper feed rollers if jams continue after reloading correctly

title: Duplex (double-sided) printing not working
symptoms: Duplex option selected but printer only prints single-sided and stops
resolution:
1. Confirm the printer's duplex unit/tray is properly seated
2. Update or reinstall the printer driver, as duplex settings can be lost after driver corruption
3. Test duplex printing directly from printer's own test-page function to isolate driver vs. hardware cause

title: Vertical lines or streaks on every printout
symptoms: Thin vertical lines appear consistently across printed pages, including blank test pages
resolution:
1. Run the printer's print-head/drum cleaning cycle
2. Inspect and clean the scanner glass/drum contacts for dust or toner residue
3. Replace the drum unit if lines persist after cleaning (usually indicates drum wear, not a settings issue)
